high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "bloombergbusiness." The post features a close-up photograph of two sleek, metallic rings placed on a white surface. The rings have a modern, minimalist design with a smooth, reflective finish. The text accompanying the image reads: "It may look like jewelry, but it's actually a digital wallet. And it doubles up as a key. Japanese company MTG is betting on smart rings as a new frontier for contactless technology. Its 'Evering' features a chip embedded in zirconia, a synthetic crystal sometimes used as a substitute for diamonds.
